catholic-encyclopedia-1913-agram-zagreb: This 1913 reference piece on Agram — Zagreb, the Croatian archdiocese. Thomas Shahan gives its history. Its twin spires crown the Kaptol hill. Bishops guarded the frontier faith. Croatia's ecclesiastical heart. Its archbishops defied the Ottoman tide. Its name means the city on the hill.
